title: A Low Similarity Score Does Not Show Independence after Source-Conditioned Repository Rewriting
title_zh: 在源条件化仓库重写之后，低相似度分数并不能证明独立性

paragraphs.en: 实验表明源条件化重写下低相似度分数不能证明代码独立性，需重复生成验证。 Maintainers sometimes cite a low token-similarity score as evidence that an LLM-assisted rewrite of a copyleft project is independent of the original. We test what such a score can support under \emph{source-conditioned} rewriting: a coding agent keeps the original in its working copy, rewrites the repository, and iterates until a fixed behavioural harness passes, with no human edit to the code. On 69 rewrites of six copyleft Python projects we find that: \ding{182}~Agent-only rewriting is inexpensive and often yields low scores. Every controlled rewrite passes the harness after repair, usually within half an hour for the initial rewrite. Under a ground-up rearchitecture prompt, most rewrites fall below 25\% JPlag similarity and still pass the harness. \ding{183}~A single low score is an unreliable witness. Identical project--agent--prompt configurations produce wide spreads in similarity; run-to-run variation dominates project and agent effects, and in more than a third of configurations the three repeats straddle the threshold. Rewrites retain more of the original's imports and fingerprint facts than unrelated projects do, yet hand-written independent implementations of the same task often retain as much, and neither signal separates the two groups better than chance. Thus a low score on one rewrite is weak evidence of independence: another run of the same agent may score high. Claims based on similarity should report repeated generations, and candidate provenance signals should be checked against same task independent implementations, not only against unrelated projects.
paragraphs.zh: 实验表明，在源条件化重写下，低相似度分数不能证明代码独立性，需要通过重复生成来验证。维护者有时会引用低 token 相似度分数作为证据，声称对 copyleft 项目的 LLM 辅助重写独立于原始项目。 我们测试了在\emph{源条件化}重写下这样的分数能支持什么：一个编码智能体将原始代码保留在其工作副本中，重写该仓库，并不断迭代直到固定的行为测试套件通过，期间没有任何人工对代码的编辑。 在对六个 copyleft Python 项目的 69 次重写中，我们发现：\ding{182}~仅由智能体完成的重写成本低廉，且常常产生低分数。 每次受控重写在修复后都能通过测试套件，初始重写通常在半小时内完成。 在从头重构架构的提示下，大多数重写的 JPlag 相似度低于 25\%，但仍能通过测试套件。\ding{183}~单个低分数是不可靠的见证。 相同的项目--智能体--提示配置产生了很大的相似度差异；运行间的波动主导了项目和智能体的影响，并且在超过三分之一的配置中，三次重复的结果跨越了阈值。 与不相关项目相比，重写保留了更多原始项目的导入语句和指纹事实，然而针对同一任务的手写独立实现往往也保留了同样多，而且这两个信号区分这两组的效果都不比随机猜测好。 因此，单次重写得到低分数是独立性的弱证据：同一个智能体的另一次运行可能会得到高分。 基于相似度的主张应报告重复生成的结果，并且候选的来源信号应针对同一任务的独立实现进行检验，而不仅仅是针对不相关项目。
